purpose: Contract for the primitive registry generation/vectorization/search pipeline. Candidate primitive records must be generated from real code/artifact inventory, carry complete I/O/provenance/proof/log/graph metadata, export search/vector rows, and remain candidate-only until a separate promotion gate accepts them.
candidate_law: Builder output is candidate evidence only: candidate=true, serves_truth=false, generated from real repo inventory, and not promoted by the builder.
placeholder_law: Reject placeholder/dummy/TODO/lorem records and reject synthetic rows unless explicitly marked as examples; synthetic examples are never promotion-ready.
promotion_law: Promotion requires resolved contracts, non-placeholder provenance/license metadata, graph edges, logs schema, passing proof receipt, and owner/human promotion review. LLM-generated candidates cannot promote as truth.
vector_law: Search/vector exports must carry deterministic embeddings with the registry enrichment embedding dimension and enough metadata to rerank by exact/keyword/label/contract/graph/semantic signals.
blocking_index_law: The builder must emit a reusable primitive_blocking_index.json inverted index over exact, keyword, label, contract, graph, mutation, and coarse semantic bucket keys so large registries can retrieve a bounded candidate set before deterministic reranking.
call_surface_law: Every primitive candidate must expose a compact call_surface with entrypoint_candidate, input/output contract shape, call boundary, and serves_truth=false so LLMs and deterministic compilers can call the primitive without reading source.
composition_law: Every primitive candidate must expose composition metadata: consumes_state, produces_state, invalidates, repeatable, idempotent, pure, side_effect_boundary, and edge_policy.
mutation_affordance_law: Every primitive candidate must expose mutation_affordances with applicable mutation hints, verified deterministic call surfaces, future candidate surfaces, deterministic_first=true, llm_generated_adapter_last_resort=true, promotion_required_for_variants=true, and serves_truth=false.
quality_sieve_law: AIDevObserver and Teleon default retrieval must use the deterministic quality sieve before surfacing reuse recommendations. Broad real-code records start at R3 candidate status; only records with clear blackbox descriptions, enriched input/output edges, practical domains, and no hard blockers can become R8_aidevobserver_surfaceable. Quality assessment never flips serves_truth.
